expansion_trigger: Add three sleep-deprivation effects distinct from existing glucose and blood-pressure propositions.

target_size_decisions.rationale: Fatigue, emotional instability and impaired judgment are distinct sleep-deprivation effects and increase physiology variation without repeating metabolic or cardiovascular propositions.
target_size_decisions.evidence: 厚生労働省 e-ヘルスネット 睡眠と生活習慣病との深い関係
